name: Orders - Full CRUD and Kanban workflow
description: Verifies orders listing, creation, detail view, editing, and Kanban board across the complete order lifecycle

planSteps.description: Log in and navigate to /dashboard/orders to see the orders list with filters
Assert that orders table is displayed with columns: ID, Client, Status, Priority, Date, Assigned To
Test search/filter functionality by typing a client name in the search bar
Click 'New Order' button and verify the creation form with all required sections loads
Fill in order form: select client, enter description, set priority, assign resources, set dates
Submit the form and verify order is created successfully and redirected to the order detail page
Assert that the new order appears in the orders list with status 'pending' or 'draft'
Click on the order row to open the detail view with tabs (Info, Costs, Execution, Evidence, Planning)
Switch to Kanban view (/dashboard/orders/kanban) and verify columns: Pending, In Progress, Completed, Approved
Drag and drop an order card from 'Pending' to 'In Progress' column
Assert that the order status updates after the drag operation
Navigate to order edit view and modify the description, then save
Assert that the updated description is displayed in the order detail
